title: 第13章 神威不可亵渎第14章 星主邀请
content_zh:
林云负手而立，神境气息源源不断地散发开来，强大的威压让整个空间都仿佛凝固。
“吕公子，现在你可知道，你的威胁是多么的可笑？”
林云的声音冰冷而威严，仿佛来自九天之上的神谕。
吕公子此刻浑身颤抖，牙齿咯咯作响：“神尊大人，饶命！
饶命啊！”
面对堂堂神境，他再也没有了丝毫脾气。
他知道如此恐怖的存在，碾死他，比碾死一只蚂蚁还要简单！
神尊一怒，别说是他，便是他吕家，神罚之下也会在顷刻之间，灰飞烟灭！
林云目光扫过跪地求饶的吕公子，又看向那柜员女子。
那商会柜员女子，此刻已跪伏在地，整个人如遭雷击，身体止不住颤抖。
当她感受到林云的目光投射，她只感觉自己的灵魂，都轰然陷入了无尽恐惧深渊。
她先前在店里怠慢、不屑、讽刺的人？竟然是堂堂神境？
她想到这里后，只感觉天旋地转，整个人一下子软瘫在地。
就在这时，一名留着整齐胡须，身着光鲜亮丽锦袍的中年男人，神色匆忙地从商会里疾步跑了出来。
“神尊大人，小的是商会会长，今日之事，是本商会怠慢了您！
还望神尊大人海量，饶恕我们的罪过！”
中年人跑出来后，毫不犹豫地立刻跪伏在地，诚惶诚恐地向林云磕头认错，额头撞击地面的声音，清晰可闻。
“你是老板？我手里的这些书，多少钱。”
林云神色淡然地看了他一眼。
“神尊大人，您说笑了，这些书就权当是小店对您的一点敬意，免费赠予神尊！”

“若神尊还有其他需求，尽可在本店随意挑选，本店通通赠送！”
商会会长的额头上，已然密密麻麻地布满了汗珠，一颗心更是紧张得仿佛要跳出嗓子眼。
发生这样的事，他着实是万万没有想到的。
毕竟他们商会售卖的物品，通常来说神境强者根本不屑一顾。
别说是神境，即便是至尊、虚道这种境界的强者，也基本不会踏入他们商会的大门。
他们商会所售卖的资源，大多是圣境及以下修士所需要的。
而事情已经发生，他只能以最大程度，去展现自己的诚意。
“书我收了，至于其他的，就不必了。
你以后，好好管教你手底下的人就行。”
林云轻描淡写道。
林云现在毕竟是神境。
这家商会里面售卖的资源，林云压根就瞧不上眼。
哪怕是将这里的资源拿回祖地，也并非稀缺资源。
林云以后要往祖地带资源，也是搞一些祖地都没有的珍贵资源，不会在这里拿。
“是是是，小人以后必定严加管教！”
content_en:
Lin Yun stood with his hands behind his back, and the divine aura continued to spread out. The powerful pressure made the entire space seem to freeze.
"Mr. Lu, now do you know how ridiculous your threat is?"
Lin Yun's voice was cold and majestic, like an oracle coming from the nine heavens.
Mr. Lu was trembling all over and his teeth were chattering: "Lord God, please spare my life!
Spare me! "
Facing the dignified divine realm, he no longer had the slightest temper.
He knows such a terrifying existence, crushing him is easier than crushing an ant!
When the god is angry, let alone him, even the Lu family will be wiped out in an instant under the punishment of the god!
Lin Yun glanced at Mr. Lu, who was kneeling on the ground begging for mercy, and then looked at the teller woman.
The woman who was the teller of the Chamber of Commerce was kneeling on the ground at this moment. Her whole body felt as if she had been struck by lightning, and her body could not stop shaking.
When she felt Lin Yun's gaze, she felt that her soul suddenly fell into the abyss of endless fear.
The person she had snubbed, disdained, and ridiculed in the store earlier? It turned out to be a dignified divine realm?
After she thought of this, she felt like the world was spinning, and her whole body suddenly collapsed to the ground.
At this moment, a middle-aged man with a neat beard and a bright brocade robe ran out of the Chamber of Commerce in a hurry.
"Lord God, I am the president of the Chamber of Commerce. What happened today is that the Chamber of Commerce has neglected you!
I also hope that the Lord God will forgive our sins! "
After the middle-aged man ran out, he immediately knelt down on the ground without hesitation and kowtowed to Lin Yun in fear to admit his mistake. The sound of his forehead hitting the ground was clearly audible.
"Are you the boss? How much do these books in my hand cost?"
Lin Yun glanced at him indifferently.
"Master Shenzun, you are joking, these books can be regarded as a little respect from the shop to you, and they are given to Shenzun for free!"
"If the deity has other needs, you can choose at our store and we will give them all away for free!"
The president of the Chamber of Commerce's forehead was already covered with beads of sweat, and his heart was so nervous that it seemed like it would jump out of his throat.
He really never expected that such a thing would happen.
After all, the items sold by their chamber of commerce are usually ignored by the powerful gods.
Not to mention the gods, even the powerful ones in the realms of Supreme and Xu Dao will basically not step into the door of their chamber of commerce.
Most of the resources sold by their chamber of commerce are needed by monks in the Holy Realm and below.
But things have already happened, and he can only show his sincerity to the greatest extent.
"I have collected the book, but as for the others, there is no need for them.
From now on, just discipline the people under you. "
Lin Yun wrote lightly.
Lin Yun is now in the divine realm after all.
Lin Yun simply looked down upon the resources sold in this chamber of commerce.
Even if the resources here are taken back to the ancestral land, they are not scarce resources.
Lin Yun will go to the ancestral land for resources in the future, and he will also get some precious resources that are not available in the ancestral land, and he will not get them here.
"Yes, yes, the villain will be disciplined strictly from now on!"
